name: nangate45-research-12m-v1
qualification: Research extension; native platform has only ten routing layers. RC estimates are not calibrated extraction models.
assumptions: Width/pitch/thickness/sheet resistance copy native M10 as a transparent starting assumption, not a process claim.
M11 horizontal and M12 vertical; 0.8um dielectric gaps and uniform epsilon_r=3.9 are explicit study assumptions.
Native M10 top is 10.09+2.0=12.09um; M11 bottom=12.89um; M12 bottom=15.69um.
0.6um cuts with 0.1um enclosure fit a prefabricated 0.8um M10 landing; no post-custom M10 patch is allowed.
Via R scales native via9 0.5ohm by (0.8/0.6)^2; this requires later calibration.
Early C estimate is epsilon0*epsilon_r*(width/gap+2*thickness/spacing) per unit length; coupling, substrate, neighbors and native-layer consistency need full extraction.
Low/base/high scales electrical estimates only; it never modifies frozen native geometry.
GDS 210..213 is a proposed research mapping; actual native mapping collision audit remains mandatory before GDS export.
